sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN INTENSE MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER CENTRAL TX THIS MORNING WILL EJECT NEWD TO THE LOWER OH VALLEY BY CHRISTMAS MORNING AS A SEPARATE CLOSED LOW DIGS SSEWD OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. THE TX WAVE WILL BE PRECEDED BY A DEEPENING CYCLONE WHICH WILL TRACK NEWD FROM EXTREME NE TX THIS MORNING TO THE MID MS VALLEY OVERNIGHT. IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE DEEPENING CYCLONE...A WARM FRONT WILL MOVE NEWD FROM LA THIS MORNING TO THE I-20 CORRIDOR IN MS/AL BY THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY TONIGHT...WHILE A COLD FRONT SURGES EWD ACROSS LA/MS TODAY TO AL AND SW GA OVERNIGHT. THE PRIMARY FOCUS FOR SEVERE STORMS WILL BE ALONG THE COLD FRONT AND WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR THROUGH TONIGHT.
